response.sql: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_count) as avg_qualifying FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_count, dc.qualifying_count / ac.avg_qualifying as ratio FROM driver_counts dc CROSS JOIN average_count ac ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
